description: This Java class defines a filter for verifying the format of device connection messages within the Eclipse Hono framework. It extends a base message filter and provides a static method to validate key message properties such as device ID, correlation ID, subject, and reply-to address.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionMessageFilter
classes.description: A final class providing static validation methods for device connection messages in the Hono framework.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Static method that checks whether a given message contains all required properties for device connection validation, including device ID, correlation ID, subject, and reply-to address.
